---
title: "Rides dashboard"
---

Starting point for the agentic SDLC lab. Daily ride counts for three cities,
July to September 2026, loaded from `data/rides.csv` by tested functions in
`rides/stats.py`.

```{python}
from rides.stats import load_rides, total_rides, rides_by_city

df = load_rides()
print(f"Total rides: {total_rides(df):,}")
rides_by_city(df)
```

## Rides by city

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Total rides per city, July to September 2026"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

by_city = rides_by_city(df)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.bar(by_city["city"], by_city["rides"], color="#028090")
ax.set_ylabel("Rides")
plt.show()
```
